rows.what: Texas oil production tax, fiscal 2025: 4.6 percent of EIA's production at the Texas first purchase price (EIA), USD
rows.document: Texas Comptroller, Historical All Funds (Excluding Trusts) Revenue, fiscal 2025
rows.why: ours is 23 percent above. What would lower collections, none of it measured here: EIA's crude oil holds lease condensate, which Texas taxes under the gas tax; oil from enhanced recovery pays 2.3 percent; an exempt owner's royalty pays nothing; and collections are cash received, with refunds and late reports

rows.what: Texas oil production tax, fiscal 2025: 4.6 percent of EIA's production at the WTI Cushing monthly mean, the tool's default, USD
rows.document: Texas Comptroller, Historical All Funds (Excluding Trusts) Revenue, fiscal 2025
rows.why: ours is 25 percent above. What would lower collections, none of it measured here: EIA's crude oil holds lease condensate, which Texas taxes under the gas tax; oil from enhanced recovery pays 2.3 percent; an exempt owner's royalty pays nothing; and collections are cash received, with refunds and late reports

rows.what: Texas natural gas production tax, fiscal 2025: 7.5 percent of EIA's marketed production at the Henry Hub monthly mean, USD
rows.document: Texas Comptroller, Historical All Funds (Excluding Trusts) Revenue, fiscal 2025
rows.why: ours is 11 percent above. What moves it, none of it measured here: Henry Hub is not the price at a Texas well; high-cost gas pays a reduced rate and low-producing wells earned a 100 percent credit in every period the Comptroller certified; marketing costs are deducted; and the Comptroller's figure also holds the condensate tax
